scope: the first I02 route: the closed, laterally uniform layered finite-strain column of the I01 controls, advanced under one accepted clock, saved, reopened and continued; a bounded supported case, not a generated world, whole-planet run or physical acceptance

column.drive: the reviewed motion-case extension drive, drag and reference width, unchanged

initial_departure.shape: amplitude_k * sin(2 pi z0 / h0) at every material point: warmer above mid-depth, cooler below

inherited_history: the weakening case's campaign initial_history_by_layer at every material point of its layer

provenance.physics: every physical input is the reviewed I01 layered column: its layers, densities, rheology, weakening law, gravity, thermal properties, boundary temperatures, drive and policy, used unchanged through the package-owned preparation
provenance.schedule: the retained finite-strain horizon of 1e14 s in 16 whole steps of 6.25e12 s, the time step of the I02.2 continuation checks; well inside the 256-step ceiling
provenance.departure: the signed 2 K departure of the I02.1/I02.2 checks, so the initial thermal content and its enthalpy are nonzero and of both signs; an authored control input, not an observation
provenance.history: the weakening case's authored inherited raw plastic history, so weakening memory is nonzero from the start
